cues.en: As an exercise, try your hand at implementing random exploration.
cues.zh: 這個練習，請你試著實作隨機探索。

cues.en: Go back to the EvaluateUserCF script way back in the collaborative filtering section of the course; it generated top-10 recommendations for every user with user-based KNN, and measure the hit rate.
cues.zh: 回到課程協同過濾那一節的 EvaluateUserCF 程式；它用使用者式 KNN，為每位使用者產生前十名推薦，並衡量命中率。

cues.en: Your challenge is to modify this code such that the last slot in your top-10 recommendations is always used to surface a random movie that was released in the most current year in the MovieLens data set.
cues.zh: 你的挑戰是修改程式碼，讓前十名推薦的最後一個位置，永遠用來呈現一部從 MovieLens 資料集最新年份中隨機挑選的電影。

cues.en: To do this, you'll have to modify our MovieLens module to identify and extract movies in the most current year it has, and modify the EvaluateUserCF script
cues.zh: 為此，必須修改 MovieLens 模組，辨識並取出資料中最新年份的電影，並修改 EvaluateUserCF 程式，

cues.en: to replace the tenth slot in each users' recommendations with one of these movies, chosen at random.
cues.zh: 把每位使用者推薦的第十個位置，換成隨機選出的一部這類電影。

cues.en: See what impact it actually has on the hit rate.
cues.zh: 看看這對命中率實際有什麼影響。

cues.en: If it doesn't impact hit rate much, then it might be a reasonable thing to do if you have a real problem with new movies not being surfaced to users quickly enough.
cues.zh: 如果對命中率影響不大，而你確實有新電影無法夠快曝光給使用者的問題，那麼這可能是合理的做法。

cues.en: Up next, I'll review my solution to this exercise.
cues.zh: 接著，我會介紹我的練習解答。
